verdict.rationale: Segment's docs describe a first-party Consent Management feature that it recommends for enforcing end-user cookie and data-collection consent preferences. Those preferences cover the types of data a user agrees to have collected, used, and shared, within a broader privacy suite aimed at GDPR and CCPA compliance. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that consent categories are mapped to specific destinations and enforced downstream automatically, detail on how opt-outs propagate, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
